afterNow.doc:
Matches times strictly after the server's `now + offset`
(`field > now + offset`). The server reads its clock once per query,
so a saved query never depends on the client's clock, and the moment is
encoded the way the query schema says the field stores time: an epoch in
its unit, or text in its pattern, in the zone `zoneId` names.

Needs a Wow server of 9.2.0 or later; an earlier one refuses `AFTER_NOW`.
tags:
@param offset - ISO-8601 duration added to now, as
`java.time.Duration.parse` reads it: days, hours, minutes and seconds,
each optionally signed, e.g. `PT0S`, `-PT30M` or `P1DT2H`. A negative
offset looks back. Defaults to `PT0S`, now itself.
@returns `{ op: 'after-now', field, offset }`, plus `zoneId` when set.
afterNow.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, offset?: string | undefined, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => NowFilter<FIELDS>

aggregateId.doc:
Matches the record whose aggregate ID equals `value`. Root-only: not allowed
inside `elementMatch`.
tags: @throws TypeError If `value` is not a string.

aggregateIds.doc:
Matches records whose aggregate ID is one of `values`. Root-only: not
allowed inside `elementMatch`.
tags: @param values - Non-empty list of aggregate IDs.
@returns `{ op: 'aggregate-ids', values }` with a copy of `values`.

@throws TypeError If `values` is empty, contains `null` or `undefined`,
or contains a non-string.

and.doc:
Matches when all of `operands` match. Returns an element-scoped
filter when every operand is element-scoped, so the result can be used
inside `elementMatch`.
tags: @param operands - Non-empty list of filter expressions.
@returns `{ op: 'and', operands }` with a copy of `operands`.

@throws TypeError If `operands` is empty or contains `null` or
`undefined`.
and.type: { <FIELDS extends string>(operands: readonly ElementFilterExpression<FIELDS>[]): ElementLogicalFilter<FIELDS>; <FIELDS extends string>(operands: readonly FilterExpression<FIELDS>[]): LogicalFilter<FIELDS>; }

beforeNow.doc:
Matches times strictly before the server's `now + offset`
(`field < now + offset`). The server reads its clock once per query,
so a saved query never depends on the client's clock, and the moment is
encoded the way the query schema says the field stores time: an epoch in
its unit, or text in its pattern, in the zone `zoneId` names.

Needs a Wow server of 9.2.0 or later; an earlier one refuses `BEFORE_NOW`.
tags:
@param offset - ISO-8601 duration added to now, as
`java.time.Duration.parse` reads it: days, hours, minutes and seconds,
each optionally signed, e.g. `PT0S`, `-PT30M` or `P1DT2H`. A negative
offset looks back. Defaults to `PT0S`, now itself.
@returns `{ op: 'before-now', field, offset }`, plus `zoneId` when set.
beforeNow.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, offset?: string | undefined, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => NowFilter<FIELDS>

beforeToday.doc:
Matches times earlier than today at the local time `time`
(`field < today at time`) in the configured time zone.
tags:
@param time - 24-hour local time: `HH:mm`, `HH:mm:ss` or `HH:mm:ss.S` with
1 to 9 fraction digits.
@returns `{ op: 'before-today', field, time }`, plus `zoneId` when set.
beforeToday.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, time: string, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => BeforeTodayFilter<FIELDS>

between.doc:
Matches records whose `field` lies in the inclusive range
`lowerBound <= field <= upperBound`.
tags: @param lowerBound - Inclusive lower bound; non-null JSON scalar.
@param upperBound - Inclusive upper bound; non-null JSON scalar.

@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or either bound is not a
string, a boolean or a finite number.
between.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, lowerBound: ComparableFilterLiteral, upperBound: ComparableFilterLiteral) => BetweenFilter<FIELDS>

contains.doc:
Matches records whose string `field` contains `value` literally. No
full-text analyzer is applied.
tags: @throws TypeError If `stringComparison` is not a {@link StringComparison}member, `field` is not a valid query field path, or `value` is not a string.
contains.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, value: string, stringComparison?: StringComparison | undefined) => StringFilter<FIELDS>

containsAll.doc: Matches records whose array `field` contains every value in `values`.
tags: @param values - Non-empty list of non-null JSON scalars.
@returns `{ op: 'contains-all', field, values }` with a copy of `values`.
containsAll.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, values: readonly ComparableFilterLiteral[]) => CollectionFilter<FIELDS>

deletion.doc:
Matches snapshots by deletion state. An explicit `DELETION` at the root or
in a root `AND` replaces the gateway's default `ACTIVE` scope. Root-only:
not allowed inside `elementMatch`.
tags: @throws TypeError If `state` is not a {@link DeletionState} member.

earlierDays.doc:
Matches times before the start of the day `days - 1` days ago, that is,
before the window that `recentDays` covers with the same `days`.
tags:
@param days - Number of calendar days, including today; an integer from
1 to 2147483647.
@returns `{ op: 'earlier-days', field, days }`, plus `zoneId` when set.
earlierDays.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, days: number, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => DaysFilter<FIELDS>

elementMatch.doc:
Matches records where a single element of the array `field` satisfies
`predicate`. Fields in `predicate` are relative to the element.
tags: @param field - Query field path of the array, e.g. `state.items`.

@returns `{ op: 'element-match', field, predicate }`.
A `SEARCH` inside it must name the fields it searches, relative to the
element (Wow 9.2 and later, where the descriptor lists
`elements[].search`); a model-wide `SEARCH` is a root filter.

@throws TypeError If `predicate` contains, at any depth, a root-only filter
(`ID`, `IDS`, `AGGREGATE_ID`, `AGGREGATE_IDS`, `TENANT_ID`, `OWNER_ID`,
`SPACE_ID`, `DELETION` or a `SEARCH` without fields) or an `AND`, `OR`
or `NOR` whose operands are empty or contain `null`, or if `field` is
not a valid query field path.
elementMatch.type: <FIELDS extends string, ELEMENT_FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, predicate: ElementFilterExpression<ELEMENT_FIELDS>) => ElementMatchFilter<FIELDS, ELEMENT_FIELDS>

endsWith.doc:
Matches records whose string `field` ends with `value` literally. No
full-text analyzer is applied.
tags: @throws TypeError If `stringComparison` is not a {@link StringComparison}member, `field` is not a valid query field path, or `value` is not a string.
endsWith.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, value: string, stringComparison?: StringComparison | undefined) => StringFilter<FIELDS>

tags:
@param value - JSON scalar. `null` is sent as is; the server rewrites it
to `IS_NULL`.

@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `value` is not
`null`, a string, a boolean or a finite number.
eq.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, value: FilterLiteral) => EqualityFilter<FIELDS>

exists.doc:
Matches records where `field` exists. On MongoDB this includes a `null`
value.
tags: @throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path.

expression.doc:
Compares a computed expression with a number, such as the hours from
`paidAt` to `shippedAt`. `{ op: 'expression', expression, comparison,
value }`.

The expression is evaluated per record, so this is an expensive
operator, admitted where the descriptor lists `EXPRESSION` in
`record.rootOperators`. A record whose expression has no value (an
operand absent or holding several values, or a division by zero) does
not match, whatever the comparison, `NE` included. Allowed at the root,
in a metric's filter and in an aggregation element's filter, but not
inside `elementMatch`. Needs a Wow server of 9.2.0 or later.
tags: @param expression - What is compared; it must read at least one field.
expression.type: <FIELDS extends string>(expression: AggregationExpression<FIELDS>, comparison: ComparisonOperator, value: number) => ExpressionFilter<FIELDS>

gt.doc:
Matches records whose `field` is greater than `value` (`field > value`).
Numbers compare at the backend's stored precision.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `value` is not a
string, a boolean or a finite number.
gt.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, value: ComparableFilterLiteral) => ComparisonFilter<FIELDS>

gte.doc:
Matches records whose `field` is greater than or equal to `value` (`field >= value`).
Numbers compare at the backend's stored precision.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `value` is not a
string, a boolean or a finite number.
gte.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, value: ComparableFilterLiteral) => ComparisonFilter<FIELDS>

id.doc:
Matches the record whose record ID equals `value`. Root-only: not allowed
inside `elementMatch`.
tags: @throws TypeError If `value` is not a string.

ids.doc:
Matches records whose record ID is one of `values`. Root-only: not
allowed inside `elementMatch`.
tags: @param values - Non-empty list of record IDs.
@returns `{ op: 'ids', values }` with a copy of `values`.

@throws TypeError If `values` is empty, contains `null` or `undefined`,
or contains a non-string.

isEmpty.doc:
Matches records whose array `field` is empty. On Elasticsearch it may also
match a missing or `null` field.
tags: @throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path.

isEmptyString.doc:
Matches records whose string `field` equals `""`. Whitespace-only
strings do not match.
tags: @throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path.

isIn.doc: Matches records whose `field` equals one of `values`.
tags: @param values - Non-empty list of non-null JSON scalars.
@returns `{ op: 'in', field, values }` with a copy of `values`.
isIn.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, values: readonly ComparableFilterLiteral[]) => CollectionFilter<FIELDS>

isNotEmptyString.doc:
Matches records whose string `field` exists, is not `null` and is not
`""`.
tags: @throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path.

isNotNull.doc:
Matches records whose `field` exists and is not `null`, following the
backend's null semantics.
tags: @throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path.

isNull.doc:
Matches records whose `field` is `null` or missing, following the
backend's null semantics.
tags: @throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path.

lastMonth.doc:
Matches times within the previous calendar month, as the half-open range `[start, end)` in the
configured time zone.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `zoneId` is
blank or an invalid UTC offset.
lastMonth.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => CalendarFilter<FIELDS>

lastWeek.doc:
Matches times within the previous Monday-start week, as the half-open range `[start, end)` in the
configured time zone.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `zoneId` is
blank or an invalid UTC offset.
lastWeek.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => CalendarFilter<FIELDS>

lastYear.doc:
Matches times within the previous calendar year, as the half-open range `[start, end)` in the
configured time zone.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `zoneId` is
blank or an invalid UTC offset.
lastYear.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => CalendarFilter<FIELDS>

lt.doc:
Matches records whose `field` is less than `value` (`field < value`).
Numbers compare at the backend's stored precision.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `value` is not a
string, a boolean or a finite number.
lt.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, value: ComparableFilterLiteral) => ComparisonFilter<FIELDS>

lte.doc:
Matches records whose `field` is less than or equal to `value` (`field <= value`).
Numbers compare at the backend's stored precision.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `value` is not a
string, a boolean or a finite number.
lte.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, value: ComparableFilterLiteral) => ComparisonFilter<FIELDS>

matchAll.doc: Matches every record in the query scope.

ne.doc: Matches records whose `field` does not equal `value`.
tags:
@param value - JSON scalar. `null` is sent as is; the server rewrites it
to `IS_NOT_NULL`.

@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `value` is not
`null`, a string, a boolean or a finite number.
ne.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, value: FilterLiteral) => EqualityFilter<FIELDS>

nextMonth.doc:
Matches times within the next calendar month, as the half-open range `[start, end)` in the
configured time zone.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `zoneId` is
blank or an invalid UTC offset.
nextMonth.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => CalendarFilter<FIELDS>

nextWeek.doc:
Matches times within the next Monday-start week, as the half-open range `[start, end)` in the
configured time zone.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `zoneId` is
blank or an invalid UTC offset.
nextWeek.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => CalendarFilter<FIELDS>

nextYear.doc:
Matches times within the next calendar year, as the half-open range `[start, end)` in the
configured time zone.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `zoneId` is
blank or an invalid UTC offset.
nextYear.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => CalendarFilter<FIELDS>

nor.doc:
Matches when none of `operands` match. Returns an element-scoped
filter when every operand is element-scoped, so the result can be used
inside `elementMatch`.
tags: @param operands - Non-empty list of filter expressions.
@returns `{ op: 'nor', operands }` with a copy of `operands`.

@throws TypeError If `operands` is empty or contains `null` or
`undefined`.
nor.type: { <FIELDS extends string>(operands: readonly ElementFilterExpression<FIELDS>[]): ElementLogicalFilter<FIELDS>; <FIELDS extends string>(operands: readonly FilterExpression<FIELDS>[]): LogicalFilter<FIELDS>; }

tags: @throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path.

notIn.doc: Matches records whose `field` equals none of `values`.
tags: @param values - Non-empty list of non-null JSON scalars.
@returns `{ op: 'not-in', field, values }` with a copy of `values`.
notIn.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, values: readonly ComparableFilterLiteral[]) => CollectionFilter<FIELDS>

or.doc:
Matches when at least one of `operands` match. Returns an element-scoped
filter when every operand is element-scoped, so the result can be used
inside `elementMatch`.
tags: @param operands - Non-empty list of filter expressions.
@returns `{ op: 'or', operands }` with a copy of `operands`.

@throws TypeError If `operands` is empty or contains `null` or
`undefined`.
or.type: { <FIELDS extends string>(operands: readonly ElementFilterExpression<FIELDS>[]): ElementLogicalFilter<FIELDS>; <FIELDS extends string>(operands: readonly FilterExpression<FIELDS>[]): LogicalFilter<FIELDS>; }

ownerId.doc:
Matches the record whose owner ID equals `value`. Root-only: not allowed
inside `elementMatch`.
tags: @throws TypeError If `value` is not a string.

recentDays.doc:
Matches times from the start of the day `days - 1` days ago until the end
of today. `recentDays(field, 7)` covers today and the six previous days.
tags:
@param days - Number of calendar days, including today; an integer from
1 to 2147483647.
@returns `{ op: 'recent-days', field, days }`, plus `zoneId` when set.
recentDays.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, days: number, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => DaysFilter<FIELDS>

search.doc:
Matches records by full-text search. Tokenization and matching depend on
the backend's analyzer. Inside `elementMatch` it must name its fields,
relative to the element; with fields given as a non-empty array literal
it returns an {@link ElementSearchFilter}, which `elementMatch` takes.
tags:
@param options - Optional `fields` (defaults to `[]`, the backend's default
search fields) and `mode` (defaults to `SearchMode.TERMS`).

@throws TypeError If `query` is not a string or is blank, `options` is
given but is `null`, an array or not an object, `mode` is not a
{@link SearchMode (unresolved)} member, or any of `fields` is not a valid query field
path.

spaceId.doc:
Matches the record whose space ID equals `value`. Root-only: not allowed
inside `elementMatch`.
tags: @throws TypeError If `value` is not a string.

startsWith.doc:
Matches records whose string `field` starts with `value` literally. No
full-text analyzer is applied.
tags: @throws TypeError If `stringComparison` is not a {@link StringComparison}member, `field` is not a valid query field path, or `value` is not a string.
startsWith.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, value: string, stringComparison?: StringComparison | undefined) => StringFilter<FIELDS>

tenantId.doc:
Matches the record whose tenant ID equals `value`. Root-only: not allowed
inside `elementMatch`.
tags: @throws TypeError If `value` is not a string.

thisMonth.doc:
Matches times within the current calendar month, as the half-open range `[start, end)` in the
configured time zone.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `zoneId` is
blank or an invalid UTC offset.
thisMonth.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => CalendarFilter<FIELDS>

thisWeek.doc:
Matches times within the current Monday-start week, as the half-open range `[start, end)` in the
configured time zone.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `zoneId` is
blank or an invalid UTC offset.
thisWeek.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => CalendarFilter<FIELDS>

thisYear.doc:
Matches times within the current calendar year, as the half-open range `[start, end)` in the
configured time zone.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `zoneId` is
blank or an invalid UTC offset.
thisYear.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => CalendarFilter<FIELDS>

today.doc:
Matches times within today, as the half-open range `[start, end)` in the
configured time zone.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `zoneId` is
blank or an invalid UTC offset.
today.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => CalendarFilter<FIELDS>

tomorrow.doc:
Matches times within tomorrow, as the half-open range `[start, end)` in the
configured time zone.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `zoneId` is
blank or an invalid UTC offset.
tomorrow.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => CalendarFilter<FIELDS>

yesterday.doc:
Matches times within yesterday, as the half-open range `[start, end)` in the
configured time zone.
tags:
@throws TypeError If `field` is not a valid query field path, or `zoneId` is
blank or an invalid UTC offset.
yesterday.type: <FIELDS extends string>(field: FIELDS, options?: RelativeTimeFilterOptions | undefined) => CalendarFilter<FIELDS>
